prs.tagLine: Live Work and Play at The Davitt

description:
The Davitt is an apartment development of 1- and 2- bedroom homes, located adjacent to Goldenbridge Luas Stop and overlooking the Grand Canal.

The complex offers generously sized 1- and 2-bedroom pet-friendly apartments set within beautiful courtyards. The apartments are finished to an extremely high specification and some of these features include: 

-	Complimentary Wi-Fi and television package
-	High-quality interior finishes and bespoke furniture packs
-	Floor to ceiling windows
-	Integrated Kitchens with modern appliances
-	Luxury bathrooms and en-suites 
-	Separate utility room with generous storage 
-	Spacious balconies / winter gardens
-	Video intercom 
-	Underground parking and secure bicycle storage
-	Excellent energy rating A2-A3 and air source heat pumps for hot water and heating
-	Landscaped Gardens with outdoor seating spaces

The communal resident amenity space is second to none and will offer residents exceptional enjoyment whether it's using the Chefs Kitchen, Lounge Area or state of the art Business Centre. The amenity space includes:

-	Concierge/Residents Manager
-	'Bring Me' Parcel Collection Service
-	State of the Art Gym
-	Residents Lounge & Library
-	Toddlers Play Area
-	Business Centre (with bookable private rooms and open plan workspaces)
-	Bookable Lounge with chef's kitchen
-	Bookable Guest Rooms
-	Media/Cinema Room
-	Children's Playground
